query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enrich_pending,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_fit_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_fit_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NOT NULL AND briefData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND salesApproachData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_sales
FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
